author: The Critical Drinker
description:
It was the film that killed Van Damme's career, and put the brakes on videogame adaptations for more than half a decade. Join me as I break down the disastrous production history of 1994's Street Fighter: The Movie. 

Get your tickets for the London meetup: https://www.tickettailor.com/events/gradualupgradeproductions/2331646
title: Production Hell - Street Fighter: The Movie
